suggestion.topic: Python AsyncIO vs Threading: When to Stop Blocking
suggestion.rationale: Addressing the perpetual confusion between concurrency models. Developers heavily search this when their I/O-bound web scrapers or APIs hit performance bottlenecks, driving high retention through a clear architectural contrast.
suggestion.hook_angle: Stop using threads for I/O-bound tasks until you see how this single-threaded event loop outperforms them by 10x.
